name: mfa-relay
description: Time-critical verification codes, forwarded at receive: deterministic (no LLM in the path), sender-verified (SPF/DKIM/DMARC via sender_check), idempotent per message, configurable at runtime. Off and inert until configured.
post_install: Restart the platform: docker compose restart endpoint-platform (applies 012_mfa_relay.sql, hot-loads the app, registers the email.received subscription).

Configure it: PUT /api/mfa-relay/settings with {"enabled": true, "sender_email": "who-sends-codes@example.com", "subject_contains": "verification code", "account_email": "your-mailbox@example.com", "recipient": "who-receives@example.com"}.
Test it before trusting it: POST /api/mfa-relay/test with {"email_id": <a stored code message>} — a dry run that returns exactly what a live message would produce, without sending.
Watch: GET /api/mfa-relay/forwards shows every decision (forwarded / withheld / ignored) with the reason.
